Before sunrise, Thanksgiving is already underway at Roswell Family Farm. 🦃

Feeders filled. Water line raised. Pen cleaned. Fresh bedding added.

As the turkeys grow, their nipple water line has to grow with them. Raising it keeps the nipples at a comfortable drinking height while providing the flock with clean water without open containers getting filled with bedding.

These ordinary morning chores are where your Thanksgiving dinner really begins—months before the turkey ever reaches the table.

Chicken Wing Pasta—with absolutely no wings required. 😄🌶️

This creamy Buffalo pasta is one of our family’s favorite ways to turn cooked chicken breast or thigh into a warm, cheesy meal.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

• 1 lb penne pasta
• 8 oz cream cheese
• ½ cup Frank’s RedHot Wing Sauce
• 1 cup chicken broth
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp kosher salt
• 1 lb cooked, shredded chicken breast or thigh
• 1 cup shredded mozzarella
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• Optional: ¼ cup ranch or blue cheese dressing

HOW TO MAKE IT:

Cook the pasta according to the package directions.

While it cooks, combine the cream cheese, Buffalo sauce, and chicken broth in a large skillet. Simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth.

Whisk in the garlic powder and salt, then stir in the shredded chicken. Fold in the cooked pasta and both cheeses. Remove from the heat and serve warm with ranch or blue cheese dressing, if desired.

On November 23, 2018, we said “I do.” Today, we’re building a life rooted in family, farming, and food worth gathering around. 💚

Emily’s family ties to Spofford Farm make our partnership especially meaningful. Working together connects Roswell Family Farm with the people who are part of our own story—and lets us share that connection with your family.

We started by raising food for our own freezer. What we didn’t expect was how much we’d love caring for the animals together, or how much it would mean when other families chose us to help fill theirs.

That’s the heart behind our whole and half hog orders: two Upstate New York farm families working together, with a place at your table in mind.
